proposed_layers.name: identity
proposed_layers.must_verify: authenticated issuer, recipient, source-event and stable full identifiers

proposed_layers.name: representation
proposed_layers.must_verify: deterministic canonical bytes, version and actual digest against actual artifact

proposed_layers.name: signing
proposed_layers.must_verify: signature, issuer identity, key validity, scope, revocation and rotation

proposed_layers.name: durable_audit
proposed_layers.must_verify: atomic tamper-evident append, retention, crash recovery and cross-process deduplication

proposed_layers.name: governance
proposed_layers.must_verify: independent receiving institutional rules, approval and resulting object readback
